$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：巨門獨坐子午，《深造講義》p.81。

basis.quote: 亦只需注意它是英华内敛，或是内心疑忌

rules.text: 你的巨門吉化而同宮不見煞，成石中隱玉格：英華內斂，可成大業；只是一生不宜走到最高峰、出鋒頭，否則容易招惹是非。
rules.en: Your Ju Men has a favourable transformation and no malefic beside it, forming the 'jade hidden in stone' pattern: brilliance held within, able to build something great; but you shouldn't push for the very top or the limelight, or trouble follows.

source.quote: 则称为[石中隐玉]，主其人英华内敛，可成大业

also.quote: 所以一生不能走最高峰，不能出锋头

rules.text: 你的巨門有祿存同宮，是石中隱玉的次格：青年時的際遇稍遜，人生多了一些阻滯。
rules.en: Your Ju Men shares the palace with Lu Cun, a lesser form of 'jade hidden in stone': your young years go a little less well, adding some obstacles.

source.quote: 因此人生便多了一些困阻

rules.text: 你的命宮見擎羊，收斂才華的本質容易轉成對別人的疑忌：表面不動聲色，心裡卻覺得人人都對自己不利，人生因此多了困境。
rules.en: Qing Yang in your Life Palace can turn the habit of holding back your talent into suspicion of others: outwardly calm, inwardly sure everyone is against you, which brings more hardship.

rules.text: 對宮的天機化忌，也令你容易生疑忌。
rules.en: Tian Ji opposite you is transformed by Ji, which also makes you prone to suspicion.

source.quote: 亦足以影响巨门具疑忌之性
